title: Japanese Money Methods
note:
METHOD FOUR — TARU WO SHIRU, the hard one. ELEVEN scenes: the -en chapter
     starts at s74, one later than the -hi row, because the promise break sits at
     the s73->s74 boundary here. The shove lives on the concat, not inside.

     Ground arc: amber on the promise break -> neutral through Ryoan-ji -> amber
     on the design -> cool as it comes apart -> warm on your own list -> red on
     the line that moved -> neutral on what happened -> the hottest red on the
     market that runs on it -> green on the question and on writing it down ->
     neutral out.

     Archetypes: A A A D D D A B A A A. D is held across s77/s78 because they are
     a matched-frame hold on one photograph AND one continuous diagram: the four
     glyphs share a square, then the square goes and they come apart. That is the
     only drawn layer in either cut that survives a scene boundary.

s74.comment: 7.1 · A · PLATE · target · amber — THERE IS A FOURTH. A mossy path in mist.

s75.comment: 7.2 · A · PLATE · no role · neutral — RYOAN-JI. Raked gravel.

s76.comment:
7.3 · A · PLATE · no role · warm — WHAT IT SAYS. The tsukubai with its
     bamboo ladle, and the inscription cited underneath.

s77.comment:
7.4 · D · BAND · target · amber — THE DESIGN. A photograph of the
     basin shows the square opening; it cannot show that four separate
     characters each use it. Four blocks around one shared square. No kicker on
     this scene, verbatim.
